description: A bed with a blue sheet and a pink pillow is in front, and several white plastic pieces, including a larger cross-shaped part, are lying near the center. The left hand stays planted on the large white piece to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand pinches a small white block on top, lifts it upward, and then moves it to the right to set it down near the other loose pieces, releasing it so nothing is held at the end.
